messages:
maria_ops: vendor just updated — H200 batch (qty 8) ETA moved +10 days from FRA dock. They offered an air-expedite option: +$12k for whole batch or $1.8k/unit for partial. AWB on current sea booking: SEA-XX123456789. @jake_sourcing @anya_finance thoughts?

jake_sourcing: rough leadtime if we don't expedite? +10 days total or distribution across hubs?

vendor_bot: Update: booking SEA-XX123456789 status=delayed; origin port congestion. Sea ETA now 2025-04-22. Air option ETA 2025-04-08. Air quote = $12,000 (all-in) or $1,800/unit. Insurance surcharge +$900 if switch to air.

liam_logistics: can we split: expedite 2 units for urgent infra needs, repool 6 from our EU pool? Cross-dock in AMS can do same-day handoffs. :thinking:

anya_finance: budget check — we have a $15k contingency for provisioning this qtr but that also covers spare repairs. $12k all-in eats most of it. Any vendor willingness to discount expedite fee?

maria_ops: cluster impact: if we lose 2 H200s for 10 days it pushes some tails on batch jobs but service-critical shards still ok. If we can get 2 asap we can unblock major training runs. @sre-oncall can you mark the affected node groups?

sre-oncall: will tag nodes as "provision-pending" and drain non-critical pods. Command I’ll run: ```kubectl label nodes -l nodepool=preemptible provision=pending && kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```

jake_sourcing: contacting vendor rep now. Goal: expedite 2 units, discount to $1k/unit, waive insurance. I'll echo back the ask + propose 30% off on full-air if they want the whole batch.

vendor_rep: Hi team — thanks for the heads-up. We can do partial air for 2 units at $1,400/unit and waive insurance only if air is booked before 18:00 UTC today. For full-batch air we can offer $9,500 total (20% off) but need an immediate commitment.

liam_logistics: if we accept partial air we need AWB labels and RMA routing note for return/reship. Also confirm whether expedited units come with export docs (we had delays before with incomplete paperwork).

vendor_rep: Export docs included. AWB will be created as AIR-AX987654321 once booked. We can attach commercial invoice + export manifest.

anya_finance: $1,400 x 2 = $2,800 + 0 insurance vs rebalancing ops cost ~ $600 in internal shifts. I prefer expedite 2 units, rebalancing 6. Approve up to $3k spend.

maria_ops: decision: expedite 2 units via air. Repool 6 from EU temporary buffer. Jake — confirm with vendor and book. Liam — prep cross-dock instructions and RMA note. Sre-oncall — proceed with node tagging.

jake_sourcing: confirmed to vendor rep, asked for AWB and ETA confirmation. Requested invoice + updated SO.

vendor_bot: Booking created AIR-AX987654321 status=booked ETA=2025-04-08 carrier=FastAir. Commercial invoice attached (link: https://vendor-portal.example.com/invoice/AX987654321).

liam_logistics: RMA note: for the 6 repooled units mark RMA type=temporary-repool, DO NOT initiate return to vendor. Add manifest code: MAN-2025-041. Shipping labelling snippet: ```print-label --awb AIR-AX987654321 --ref MAN-2025-041 --to AMS-CDX```

vendor_rep: Will send invoice and AWB docs in 10m. We will also mark the sea booking for the remaining units to be held at FRA until repool completed.

sre-oncall: nodes annotated and drain in progress. ETA for services to rebalance ~ 6 hours after nodes come up with new H200s.

maria_ops: thanks all — I'll close this thread once vendor sends invoice and ops confirms cross-dock handoff. :thumbsup:

jake_sourcing: follow-up: vendor agreed to provide a 45-day SLA credit if future sea delays >7 days. Noted for procurement terms.

liam_logistics: leaving a checklist: [ ] AWB docs received [ ] Labels printed [ ] Cross-dock pickup scheduled [ ] Internal transfer manifest submitted [ ] Node reprovision verified

maria_ops: checklist updated in ops board and assigned. Closing once final docs are in our finance bucket.
